segments.sn22.105:1.2: “Sakkāyañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi sakkāyasamudayañca sakkāyanirodhañca sakkāyanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
segments.sn22.105:1.7: Seyyathidaṃ – rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho, viññāṇupādānakkhandho.
segments.sn22.105:1.10: Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā … pe … kāmataṇhā, bhavataṇhā, vibhavataṇhā – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayo.
segments.sn22.105:1.13: Yo tassāyeva taṇhāya … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodho.
